workload.input_policy: controlled persistent-kernel trace with task count, generated task registry, and launch metadata recorded
workload.output_policy: correctness output plus MPK profiling trace
workload.batch_or_concurrency: single-process persistent-kernel run aligned with PTO persistent-device task-count and resource-policy captures

model_access.why: MPK persistent-scheduler bring-up uses public Qwen model artifacts; unauthenticated Hugging Face API snapshots are stored under tmp/sources/huggingface/.

import_target.notes: Importer must preserve MPK task registry, generated kernel metadata, profiling trace, and timing fields so the row can be compared with PTO persistent-device scheduler traces.
